lists.title: Veritas
lists.subtitle: Project Management Platform
lists.description: A web-based platform that helps clients track project progress, coordinate with vendors or freelancers, and handle payments through an escrow system.

case_study.problem: You scroll a group chat to find who approved the last milestone. You miss the message. You pay for work you have not seen.
case_study.solution: I built one board. I show the same milestones to client and freelancer. I hold payment in escrow. You release it when you approve the deliverable.
highlights: One board holds milestones, files, and approvals in one place
Escrow releases after you approve. Roles lock who sees what

lists.title: Electa
lists.subtitle: Digital Voting Platform
lists.description: A web-based voting application designed to make elections more practical, transparent, and accessible.

case_study.problem: You print 400 ballots. You count by hand for three hours. Students crowd the table and you hear doubts about the result.
case_study.solution: I kept the ballot simple. You tap your choice on any phone. I count the moment you submit. I show a live tally you can audit. I lock one vote per student.
highlights: One vote per student, verified before you submit
Live tally with audit trail on every device

lists.title: Rosa
lists.subtitle: AI-Powered Text-To-3D Floorplan Layout Generator
lists.description: A web-based platform that turns natural-language room descriptions into walkable 3D floorplan layouts, reasoning about adjacencies and spatial constraints.

case_study.problem: You describe a room with light from the north. You sketch walls for an afternoon. The client asks for the door on the other side and you start over.
case_study.solution: I built Rosa to read your text. I map adjacency and place walls. I render a plan you can walk in the browser. You type a follow-up and I move the door.
highlights: Text to 3D in the browser. You see the plan at once
Follow-up prompts move walls without redrawing
